gloss: to manage; to administer; to control; to maintain
notes:
An extremely common and versatile word covering management, administration, and maintenance in many domains: property, health, data, employees, finances, and more. The noun {管理|かんり} is used extensively in compound words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理|かんり}{者|しゃ}: manager, administrator
- {管理|かんり}{費|ひ}: management fee, maintenance fee
- {管理|かんり}{職|しょく}: managerial position
- {品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}: quality control
- {健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}: health management
- {自己|じこ}{管理|かんり}: self-management
- {管理|かんり}{社会|しゃかい}: controlled society, surveillance society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経営|けいえい}する: to run, to operate — specifically about running a business or organization
- {運営|うんえい}する: to operate, to run — focuses on the day-to-day running of an organization or event
- {監督|かんとく}する: to supervise — emphasizes oversight and directing people
- {維持|いじ}する: to maintain — focuses on keeping something in its current state

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {管|かん} (pipe, control) + {理|り} (reason, arrange). The original sense is of channeling and ordering things properly.

definitions.gloss: to manage; to administer; to control; to maintain
definitions.explanation: to oversee and control the operation, maintenance, or condition of something; to be in charge of managing resources, property, or systems

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}を{管理|かんり}する。
パスワードは{厳重|げんじゅう}に{管理|かんり}してください。
このビルは{管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}が{管理|かんり}している。
examples.english: This building is managed by a management company.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}をシステムで{一元|いちげん}{管理|かんり}することで{効率|こうりつ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Efficiency improved by managing inventory centrally through a system.
